description: Validate the PR14913 lazy component registry through the real Langflow Assistant UI on exact revision d14. The journey signs in, creates a fresh flow, explicitly selects IBM WatsonX granite-4-h-small for the Assistant, accepts its three-component Agent proposal, and receives a real WatsonX Playground response.

journeys.title: PR14913: Assistant builds and runs a WatsonX Agent flow
journeys.goal: Use Langflow Assistant to create and run a working Chat Input to Agent to Chat Output flow
journeys.because: the Assistant must discover and instantiate built-in components correctly while the component registry is lazy

state: Use the fresh browser context and dedicated database at http://127.0.0.1:7864.
Sign in only with the reviewed environment references; never invent or display credential values.
Create a new flow through the visible UI; do not open or modify any existing flow.

steps.do: Navigate to /, fill Username with ${LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER}, fill Password with ${LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD}, and submit Sign In once.
steps.see: The authenticated Langflow workspace is visible, including either the New Flow control on the projects dashboard or the Create first flow control on a first-run workspace, and the sign-in form has disappeared.

steps.do: Create a separate fresh flow through the visible UI: activate the New Flow button once when the projects dashboard is shown, or activate Create first flow once when the first-run workspace is shown. Do not open or modify an existing flow. Wait for the new flow editor to settle.
steps.see: A fresh blank flow editor is visible at a /flow/ URL, with the Langflow Assistant control or its What do you want to build welcome surface available.

steps.do: Open Langflow Assistant if its Assistant prompt is not already visible. Open the displayed current-model selector, then activate the IBM WatsonX menu item named ibm/granite-4-h-small exactly once.
steps.see: The visible Langflow Assistant prompt shows ibm/granite-4-h-small as its selected model. A model-performance advisory is acceptable; an authentication or provider-configuration error is not.

steps.do: In the Langflow Assistant textbox, submit exactly this request once: Build a flow with Chat Input connected to Agent connected to Chat Output. Configure the Agent with IBM WatsonX model ibm/granite-4-h-small and the system prompt 'Answer briefly.' Do not add any other components. While generation is active, wait up to 60 seconds for its visible Stop button to become hidden; do not repeatedly read or resubmit.
steps.see: Langflow Assistant visibly completes a proposed or live-built flow with exactly ChatInput, Agent, and ChatOutput, reports 3 components and 2 connections, and identifies IBM WatsonX ibm/granite-4-h-small with the system prompt Answer briefly. No authentication, quota, registry, or component-loading error is visible.

steps.do: Apply the completed Assistant proposal once without creating duplicate nodes: activate Add to canvas if offered; otherwise activate Replace canvas if offered on this fresh disposable test flow; otherwise dismiss the completed proposal only if the current canvas already visibly contains exactly the requested three nodes and two connections. Wait for the canvas to settle.
steps.see: The canvas visibly contains exactly Chat Input, Agent, and Chat Output connected in that order, with no duplicate nodes. The Agent visibly shows Language Model ibm/granite-4-h-small.

steps.do: Activate Playground once and wait for its chat message textbox to become usable.
steps.see: Playground is visible for the current three-component flow with an enabled Send a message textbox.

steps.do: In the Playground textbox, send exactly one message: Reply with exactly: WATSONX VERIFIED. While the flow is running, wait up to 60 seconds for its visible Stop button to become hidden; do not repeatedly read or resubmit.
steps.see: The Playground visibly shows the submitted user message followed by a completed real assistant response containing WATSONX VERIFIED. No authentication, quota, missing-model, build, registry, or custom-component error is visible.
